content: elastix core (5.2.0) supports fixed/moving image masks via -fMask/-mMask CLI flags (binary mask images; masked pixels excluded from optimization), and mask-supported registration is documented to significantly improve registration accuracy (9-12pp Dice improvement in tissue-mask literature) vs unmasked. However, ABBA's Fiji GUI Elastix wrapper (BIOP ijl-utilities-wrappers, used by the standalone ABBA 'Register' command) does NOT expose a mask parameter in its documented Register/Save/Load commands -- using a tissue mask with elastix inside the pinned ABBA/QuPath 0.6.0 workflow would require bypassing ABBA's GUI and running elastix CLI directly + hand-converting the resulting transform into ABBA's expected JSON transform-sequence format, which is unsupported/custom and risky for a 5-section run.
